The '''Jinwa Raiders''' were a group of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A band of Jinwa Raiders was defeated when [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were forced to pilot a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] transport to [[Ladro]]. The attack on the transport killed the command crew, but the droids managed to avoid capture and safely reach Ladro.
